build_tpu_backend: build a PyTorch TPU backend instance with bootstrap info and communication parameters
run_all_reduce: run an all-reduce collective operation across TPU cores using xm.all_reduce
run_all_gather: run an all-gather collective operation to collect tensors from all TPU cores
run_benchmark_comms: run a communication benchmark across TPU cores using xmp.spawn
alloc_embedding_tables: allocate embedding tables with random weights on a TPU device
